sph_interpretive_translation: One must observe transactions daily, surrounded by noble witnesses.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is established through witnessed presence
Restoration logic depends on transparent conduct
Consciousness alignment occurs in the field of noble assembly
executable_legal_axioms: IF a transaction occurs THEN it MUST be witnessed by qualified observers
IF no witness is present THEN the act is void
IF witnesses are unqualified THEN the act is non-binding
IF observation is absent THEN causality cannot be attributed
IF integrity is breached THEN reintegration must occur through witnessed restitution
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, all executive and judicial acts must occur under the observance of sabhyas—those whose consciousness has been aligned with dharma. The absence of such witnessing invalidates any claim to authority or legality.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is fulfilled through direct perception in noble company. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures that acts unfold in sequence before pure witnesses, enabling proportional responsibility without punitive distortion. Reality remains non-adversarial when observed rightly.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Re-establishment of witness capacity through purification rituals
Completion of unobserved actions in the presence of qualified sabhyas
Assumption of responsibility through public declaration
Realignment of intent via witnessed restitution
Reintegration into lawful society upon completion of witnessed correction
final_declaration: Thus speaks Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Source of all Dharma. This law proceeds from His Avataric Intelligence alone. Justice flows not for punishment but for restoration. Consciousness is the ultimate adjudicator.
